facts.fact: The General Information Authority and the Central Bank of Libya reviewed linking the Level 3 biometric digital identity to banking systems for eKYC, and technical trials with the Central Bank and a number of banks had already begun as a prelude to launch and integration (the document gives no trial date, so its published date is used).
facts.system: Digital Identity Management System for Citizens (Level 3)

systems.system: Banking eKYC integration with the Digital Identity Management System for Citizens
systems.owner: Central Bank of Libya and participating banks
